value.rationale: Choosing exactly three sensors in \(K_{m,3}\) naturally tests whether filling the entire higher-degree side is preferable to spreading leaders across the two communities. The theorem exhibits two distinct gain-driven reallocations separated by size m, four integer regimes, sharp critical gains, tie classification, and a large-size scaling law. This is a structural family theorem, not a single computed example or routine normalization.
